% 10.09.2024 CRL.M.A. 27399/2024 (Exemption) Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

1. The Petitioners have approached this Court for quashing FIR No.319/2022 dated 17.03.2022 registered at Police Station Aman Vihar for offences punishable under Sections 498A, 406, 34 IPC on the ground that the parties have amicably resolved their disputes and started living together happily.
The present FIR is the outcome of a matrimonial dispute between the parties.
2. It is stated that the parties have amicably resolved their disputes and have mutually agreed to reside together.
It is stated by the Complainant/Respondent No.2 that she does not have any objection if the This is a digitally signed order.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 21/09/2024 at 08:42:11 present FIR against the Petitioners is quashed.
Respondent No.2 has also filed an affidavit stating that they are happily living together and now there is no dispute between them and she has no objection to the quashing of the present FIR.
3. The Petitioners and Respondent No.2 are present in Court today.
The parties have been identified by the Investigating Officer.
Respondent No.2 states that she has settled all her disputes with the Petitioners and started living together out of her own free will, without pressure, coercion or undue influence.

The instant case is squarely covered by the law laid down by the Apex Court in Gian Singh vs. State of Punjab, (2012) 10 SCC 303.

5. The petition stands disposed of in the above terms, along with pending application(s), if any.
